title: Wall decors
author: Rituparna Khan
text:
Decors
Souvenirs
Paintings
Momentoes.

A wall is ornated with
lifeless outbursts of livelihood.

It is drawn.....oh yeah
Constructed tall and strong.
Deconstruction of relationship.

Debt

You think she`s an one
from the quarters!
You`re in fool`s paradise.

You`ve to die a thousand deaths
to beget life.

She has died a million deaths.

She is the quarter absorbing
one-fourth of sins you beget for her.

You owe her one true lifetime.

Gifted present

Present is not present in previous dusky drape.
Present is not present in next dawn`s enigma.
Present is what present is.
Present is in ecumene.

Present is gifted present from life
Present is gifted present to life.
Present is only truth.
Only present is life.
